name: sports-odds-comparison
title: Pry Sports Odds Comparison
description: Real-time sports odds comparison across 112+ sportsbooks. Find the best line on every bet, detect arbitrage opportunities, and identify +EV bets with closing line value analysis. Covers NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAA, soccer, tennis, golf, MMA, and more. Updates every minute with line movement tracking.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Sports Odds Comparison
input.description: Real-time sports odds comparison across 112+ sportsbooks: best lines, arbitrage detection, and +EV opportunities with line movement tracking.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process (ESPN / odds API endpoints to scrape).

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Sport filter: all, nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, ncaaf, ncaab, soccer, mma, tennis, or any supported league key.

market_types.title: Market Types
market_types.description: Which markets to compare: h2h (moneyline), spreads, totals.

include_arbitrage.title: Include Arbitrage Detection
include_arbitrage.description: Detect arbitrage opportunities across books: legs, books, guaranteed ROI, stake split.

include_ev.title: Include +EV Bets
include_ev.description: Identify +EV opportunities: fair probability, best price, edge percentage, EV per unit.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
